summary: Iteration 24 - New P1 Features Testing Complete. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). Tested: cleanup-inactive endpoint, member avatar upload, accounting transactions with summary.
seed_data_creation: Test members created and cleaned up during testing (TEST_active_*, TEST_paid_*, TEST_avatar_*, TEST_reg_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 tested all new P1 features: 1) POST /api/members/cleanup-inactive - deletes members with status in [suspended, pending, blocked], created 60+ days ago, no recent access, no paid transactions. Returns deleted_count and deleted_members list. 2) POST /api/upload/avatar - member can upload own avatar using their JWT token. Updates member.avatar_path. Rejects non-image files. 3) GET /api/accounting/transactions - returns transactions with summary containing paid_count, pending_count, total_paid, total_pending, total_count. Supports status filter. 4) POST /api/members/register with plan_id - returns pending status and requires_payment=true (verified from iteration_23).

cleanup_inactive_members.details: Returns deleted_count, deleted_members list, message, and criteria. Does NOT delete active members. Does NOT delete members with paid transactions.

member_avatar_upload.details: Member can upload own avatar using their JWT token. Updates member.avatar_path in database. Rejects non-image files (400). Requires authentication (401/403).

accounting_transactions_summary.details: Returns transactions list with summary containing paid_count, pending_count, total_paid, total_pending, total_count. Supports status filter (paid/pending). Enriches transactions with member_name, member_code, plan_name.

registration_with_plan.details: Registration with plan_id returns member with status='pending' and requires_payment=true

mocked_apis_list: SMTP email sending (welcome email with payment button logs attempt but no actual email sent - no SMTP configured)
